description: Binary tree rooted at 0 with children structure: 0->{1,2}, 1->{3,4}, 2->{5,6}. The permutation decomposes into two disjoint cycles on the tree: a 3-cycle (1,3,4) spanning the left subtree and a 4-cycle (0,5,2,6) spanning the right subtree and root. The token swapping optimum on this tree is 5.
